{{Top|leg}}
A '''reclamation plant''' was a facility where scrap metal and other junk materials were recycled. [[Jarael]] hauled scrap metal for a [[Kedorzhan]] reclamation plant in the [[Lower City]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to buy food until it was closed down.
